AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 100 °C

2. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Selected Crop? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Selected Crop.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Selected Crop.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Selected Crop.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Selected Crop.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves.

5. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Glucose and oxygen

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.

7. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying General Crop Harvesting? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to General Crop Harvesting.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for General Crop Harvesting.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on General Crop Harvesting.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about General Crop Harvesting.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Weed control? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Weed control.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Weed control.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Weed control.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Weed control.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Land Preparation? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Land Preparation.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Land Preparation.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Land Preparation.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Land Preparation.

11. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B.

13. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

14. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

15. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

16. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Tools and Equipment 3.2 Product Processing and Value Addition 3.3 Establishing A and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Tools and Equipment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Product Processing and Value Addition and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Establishing Agricultural Enterprise 3.4 Marketing Agricultural Produce 3.5 Comp and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Establishing Agricultural Enterprise and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Marketing Agricultural Produce 3.5 Composting Techniques Page 15 of 62 1 STRAND  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
